channel.title: Hulsey for House — News
channel.description: Updates from Rep. Leigh Hulsey and the Hulsey for House campaign.

item.title: Hulsey Legislation Limiting Data Center Tax Abatements Passes Legislature
item.description: House Bill 399, sponsored by Rep. Hulsey, reduces the maximum abatement period for data processing centers from 30 years to 20.

item.title: Hulsey Announces Re-Election Campaign for House District 15
item.description: State Rep. Leigh Hulsey announced her campaign for re-election to the Alabama House of Representatives, District 15.

item.title: More Than $360,000 in Grant Funding Delivered to District 15
item.description: Working with local officials, Rep. Hulsey has secured grant funding for community needs and local projects across House District 15.

item.title: From the Helena City Council to the Alabama House
item.description: Rep. Hulsey's service on the Helena City Council shaped the approach she has taken in Montgomery.

item.title: Governor Ivey Signs the FOCUS Act Into Law
item.description: House Bill 166, sponsored by Rep. Hulsey, prohibits student cell phone use in Alabama public schools during the school day.
